Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting certain food establishments from serving food containing trans fat.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting the use of trans fats in foodestablishments; and adding a new chapter to Title 69 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Beginning July 1, 2010, a food establishmentoperating under a permit issued by a local public health officer maynot serve food containing artificial trans fat. The restriction ofartificial trans fat includes any food held for service, used inpreparation of any menu item, or served in any food establishment.This restriction does not apply to food served directly to patrons ina manufacturer's original sealed package or any food served in aschool.

Except as otherwise provided in thissection, a food establishment must maintain onsite the original labelsfor all food products that contain fats, oils, or shortenings that ithas purchased. Documentation from the manufacturers of such foodproducts, indicating whether they contain vegetable shortening,margarine, or any kind of partially hydrogenated vegetable oil, or p. 1 SB 5857indicating trans fat content, may be maintained instead of originallabels.
The director of a local public healthjurisdiction or the director's authorized representative is directed toenforce the artificial trans fat restriction and requirements underthis chapter.

Unless the context clearly requiresotherwise, the definitions in this section apply throughout thischapter. (1) "Food containing trans fat" means a food that is labeled as,lists as an ingredient, or has vegetable shortening, margarine, or anykind of partially hydrogenated vegetable oil. Food with a nutritionfacts label or other documentation from the manufacturer listing thetrans fat content of the food as less that 0.5 grams per serving shallnot be deemed to contain artificial trans fat. (2) "Local public health officer" has the same meaning as in RCW70.24.017.
Sections 1 through 4 of this act constitutea new chapter in Title 69 RCW.
